paragraphs.text: Altanak is a creature on Duskmourn that is summoned by saying its name three times.
Altanak is a massive insectoid beast with giant claws, a glowing chitinous head, and large, wicked mandibles.

Altanak is a fusion of human and insect flesh, one of Valgavoth 's earliest experiments during the rise of the House . As Valgavoth's strength and influence grew, so did his twisted creations, with Altanak standing out as a grim testament to his unchecked power. Its name, Altanak, echoes the distorted noises it made while being brought into existence — noises that some survivors believe were an attempt to utter a spell meant to end Valgavoth's life. Because of this legend, there are those desperate enough to try to reconstruct that lost incantation, using the creature's name as a starting point for their forbidden rites.

But repeating Altanak's name comes with a terrible cost: for Altanak, the very sound of its name is a cruel reminder of the torment it endured at Valgavoth's hands. Worse still, it possesses the sharpest hearing of any being on Duskmourn , able to catch the faintest whisper carried through the halls. Survivors who dare to speak the name too often may soon find themselves hunted by Altanak itself, driven by a desperate need to silence the echoes of its suffering.
